in_latin.name: Zelinda
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum a lingua Hebraica derivatum
in_latin.long_meaning: Nominis Zelinda significatio a lingua Hebraica est, quae significat zelotypiam, et amoris fervorem. In Veteri Testamento, zelotypia erat virtus, quae Deum in corde suo habuerunt. Sed in Novo Testamento, zelotypia est virtus, quae Deum in carne sua habuerunt. Zelinda est nomen, quod significat zelotypiam et amoris fervorem. Et ideo, qui nomen Zelinda habent, eos qui zelotypiam et amoris fervorem habent.

in_english.name: Zelinda
in_english.meaning: Zelinda means a person with strong zeal and fervent love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zelinda originates from the Hebrew word יהיוי (הבשה) which means jealousy or zeal, and the Latin suffix -inda, making it a feminine given name. In the Bible, zeal is a virtue attributed to the prophets and the righteous. However, in the New Testament, zeal is a virtue attributed to Jesus Christ, who embodied the true meaning of zeal and love. Therefore, the name Zelinda signifies a person who embodies the virtues of zeal, love, and devotion to God.
